blocks.text:
Explanation:- A hoarder is one who, at a time when people are in great need, generally when grain is not available, hoards grain in expectation of a rise in prices.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ ﵁ يَقُوْلُ: اِنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: اَلْمُؤْمِنُ اَخُو الْمُؤْمِنِ، فَلَا يَحِلُّ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ اَنْ يَبْتَاعَ عَلَي بَيْعِ اَخِيْهِ، وَلَا يَخْطُبَ عَلَي خِطْبَةِ اَخِيْهِ حَتّي يَذَرَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب تحريم الخطبة علي خطبة اخيه ...، رقم:٣٤٦٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “A Mu'min is the brother of another Mu'min. It is not permissible for a believer to bargain while his brother is bargaining! Likewise, when his brother has sent a proposal asking for a woman in marriage, it is not permissible to send a proposal asking for the same woman!. However, if a relationship has not come about between the one who first proposed and the woman's family, then it is not wrong to send a proposal afterwards.” Hazrat Uqbah ibn Amir (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- There are several meanings for bargaining while another is bargaining. One of them is that, at the moment when the bargaining between two people has been concluded, a third person says to the seller, “Break off the deal with this man and sell your goods to me.” To act correctly in dealings, ask the Ulama about the rulings and learn them. The meaning of a marriage proposal upon a marriage proposal is: a person had proposed for a woman somewhere, and the woman's family had reached the point of accepting it. At this time a third person (while knowing about the proposal) must not send a proposal asking for this same woman.
(Fath-ul-Mulhim)
